name: GammaRips
description: Options-flow intelligence primitives for AI agents: a hard-curated overnight candidate pool, point-in-time features, realized opportunity surfaces (MFE/MAE excursions), bracket outcome labels, and methodology playbooks. Your agent reasons to its own contract and exit — no pick endpoint. Paper-traded research data; educational only; not investment advice.

auth.note: Two ways in. API key: 5 free-tier tools work without a key (get_pool preview view, get_regime_context, get_market_calendar_status, get_playbook, get_daily_report); the 4 pro tools plus the full pool (get_pool enriched/raw/features, get_signal, get_liquidity, query_outcomes, replay_contract) require a GammaRips API key (gr_live_...) sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. OAuth 2.1: connect to https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro and sign in with your GammaRips account when the client asks; the access token carries your subscription tier (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and any OAuth-capable MCP client). Headless agents can mint client_credentials tokens from a machine client created on https://gammarips.com/account. Get access at https://gammarips.com/pricing.

publication_time: pool ~05:30 ET weekdays; labels/surfaces T+1 after window close
universe: about 3,500 optionable US stocks scanned nightly; ~50-name curated BULLISH pool daily
